== Summary ==
Boba Fett, the guest image for [[Jeremy Bulloch]] on the special guests page. Graphic: Decipher. See [[DecipherCon 1999 website]] and [[DecipherCon 1999 photographs]].

== Source ==
* Shown on: [http://www.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/specialguests.html DecipherCon 1999 special guests], Decipher (1999). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19991128114040/http://www.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/specialguests.html Internet Archive]
* Image: [http://www.decipher.com/libraryimages/calendars/event/1999/mainevents/deciphercon/guest_boba.gif guest_boba.gif] (121×111). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20000516061905/http://www.decipher.com/libraryimages/calendars/event/1999/mainevents/deciphercon/guest_boba.gif Internet Archive]
* Identification: the page lists it as "Jeremy Bulloch - Boba Fett".
